target: Fully Codex-controlled, Turso-backed Oracle research and paper/shadow system
legacy_scope: AntiGravity/AG is inherited code, rules, units, and artifacts only; it is not the target agent or architecture.
global_invariants: Turso is the production source of truth.
CSV, Excel, SQLite, and Streamlit are prohibited production sources, caches, write targets, and fallbacks.

No recommendation, approval event, order, trading action, email, sniper activation, snapshot validation or promotion, production schema application, or weakened safeguard occurs without Avi's explicit scoped approval.
A shell exit, producer log, or prior conversation is insufficient completion proof.
Every long job has a unit, InvocationID, PID, exact command, immutable code identity, start time, root-owned durable checkpoint, declared maximum checkpoint interval, resources, and Turso readback.
Every failed, stalled, blocked, or no-qualifying-output event preserves evidence, prevents duplicate or deterministic retry, and launches all independent SAFE_NOW successors.
Guarded ingestion owns resource priority over research workers.
One writer is allowed per idempotency key and output namespace.
Observational lead-lag screening is not called causal proof; independent edges use lags 1-7 and depth 1-5 without a forced chain.
Research advances to backtest and paper/shadow only through documented evidence; live use is outside this plan.

universal_test_auto_fix_protocol: Preflight authoritative state and resource/safety gates.
Freeze exact run envelope, idempotency key, liveness, safety assertions, and rollback.
Run affected and full regression suites with exact counts/skips.
Run static, secret, forbidden-source/action, SQL, path, and dependency scans.
Deploy immutable closure atomically and read it back.
Observe persistent live identity, progress, checkpoint age, resources, and journal.
Independently reconstruct output and lineage from immutable files/Turso.
Fault-inject the declared stage failure matrix in an isolated safe scope.
Classify transient, deterministic technical, scientific/no-output, dependency, approval, or contradiction.
Preserve evidence, prevent duplicates, apply smallest reversible repair, retest, create new immutable identity, and resume same operation if authorized.
Rollback candidate and retain quarantine evidence on failed observation/verification.
Start every independent SAFE_NOW successor and attach long work to persistent units.
Append exact evidence state, counts, hashes, timestamps, unknowns, and required Avi action.

required: Every stage has every required field and nonempty value.
Forbidden actions are only prohibition, negative test, or explicit approval boundary.
Scenario walk covers ingestion false-red, endpoint mismatch, delayed visibility, duplicate run, stale checkpoint, checksum/provider failure, no-output, and resource contention.
Every scenario preserves evidence, prevents duplicate retry, preserves gates, starts safe successors, and names rollback.
Independent reviewer cross-checks Markdown, JSON, repository rules, and skill.
Every exit proof is independently observable and stronger than shell exit.
Approval boundaries are precise and safe recovery is autonomous.
Final stage retires continuity and legacy only after all prerequisites.
